title: Iterative POC runway & decision ledger
body:
Purpose:
This is a working runway document for customer POCs that need an iterative, decision-driven cadence. Designed to be used during workshops, sprint planning, and handoffs to delivery/ops. Not final — living ledger of decisions, blockers, and next-step owners.

Scope:
- Focus: 6- to 12-week technical pilots for inference integration (hosted/dedicated/private).
- Deliverables: baseline performance report, integration checklist, rollback/fallback plan, cost runbook, and stakeholder acceptance criteria.
- Out of scope: long-term infra ownership and production billing changes (these move to account team/SM after acceptance).

High-level timeline (iterative runway view):
Week 0 (contract + kickoff): sign MSA + data access OK. Kickoff workshop: technical owners, SRE lead, security reviewer, and customer PM.
Week 1-2 (discovery & baseline): collect sample traffic, request rates, latency SLOs. Baseline runs on small instance; run reference prompts for accuracy check.
Week 3-4 (prototype deploy): deploy a staging model route, enable prefix caching, measure p50/p95. Quick iteration: quantization candidate if token cost > target.
Week 5-7 (stress & edge cases): scale load tests, simulate cache miss patterns, validate fallback to lighter model. Security review and data-flow diagram sign-off.
Week 8-9 (business validation): product owners exercise flows, acceptance criteria signoff, cost forecast verified.
Week 10+ (handoff or extend): either handoff to Dedicated/Private path or extend pilot for production readiness.

Milestones and owners (short form):
- KICKOFF WORKSHOP: Owner = Priya Patel, Date target = 2025-10-06
- BASELINE REPORT: Owner = Ava Chen, Date target = 2025-10-17
- STAGING ENDPOINT LIVE: Owner = Diego Morales, Date target = 2025-10-24
- PERFORMANCE REVIEW: Owner = Samir Rao, Date target = 2025-11-07
- CUSTOMER ACCEPTANCE: Owner = Customer PM (TBD), Date target = 2025-11-14

Decision ledger (living):
#ID | Date | Decision | Owner | Rationale | Status
D-001 | 2025-10-03 | Use hosted API for initial prototype instead of on-prem | Priya Patel | Faster onboarding, avoid infra delays; customer agreed to sandbox data only | accepted
D-002 | 2025-10-09 | Quantize model to int8 for staging tests | Ava Chen | Token cost reduction target; need to validate quality regression | pending-validation
D-003 | 2025-10-12 | Enable prefix KV caching for conversational flows | Diego Morales | Observed repeated prompt prefixes in sample traffic | accepted

Open blockers (short):
- Customer KMS access still pending (security ticket SEC-243). Owner: Diego Morales.
- Legal MSA revision requested by customer (clauses around data retention). Owner: Priya Patel.
- Rate-limit expectations unclear for peak-burst traffic pattern. Owner: Samir Rao (to sync with customer ops).

Workshop notes (raw):
- Kickoff 10/06: quick wins: sandbox tokenization, small-batch streaming enabled.
- Customer asked for golden prompt set — we should collect 20 canonical prompts across three priority flows. Action: Customer to supply by 10/10.
- Demo idea: compare hosted baseline vs quantized staging on 5 latency-sensitive queries. Keep scripts in GH repo.
- Slack: customer concerned about GDPR controls; schedule security deep-dive (30m).

Acceptance criteria (minimum):
- Functional: end-to-end request -> response for all priority flows without errors > 98% over 24h test window.
- Latency: p95 <= 750ms on staging for typical payload sizes (<= 512 tokens).
- Cost: projected 30-day token-run cost within 25% of initial estimate.
- Quality: qualitative review by product leads (customer) shows no material regressions on golden prompt set.

Runbook snippets (quick checks for each deploy):
- Pre-deploy: verify model version pinned, KV cache warmers enabled, metric hooks (trace_id) present.
- Post-deploy smoke: run 10 canonical queries, check embeddings consistency, confirm no rate-limit exceptions.
- Rollback: automatic fallback to stable model variant if error rate > 3% sustained over 5m.

Risks & mitigations (bullet):
- Risk: Large variance in token lengths -> unexpected cost. Mitigation: enforce max token caps and recommend prompt truncation patterns.
- Risk: Customer data sensitivity requires private deployment. Mitigation: pre-approve Private checklist and schedule on-prem timeline; estimate 4-6 weeks extra.
- Risk: Third-party analytics pipeline adds latency. Mitigation: instrument sampling and run path latency without analytics.

Open questions to resolve this week:
- Q1: Which model family (open vs verified stack) will the customer permit for production? (depends on IP/third-party licenses). Owner: Priya.
- Q2: Exact SLOs for burst windows (we need 95th percentile target for traffic beyond baseline). Owner: Samir to confirm.

Action items (next 7 days):
- Priya: finalize kickoff notes and share with customer; attach acceptance criteria (due 2025-10-07).
- Ava: run quantization quality sweep on 50 queries and post results to GH (due 2025-10-14).
- Diego: escalate KMS access with Security (SEC-243) and update ledger when granted (due 2025-10-09).
- Samir: run synthetic burst test and capture p95/p99 numbers (due 2025-10-12).

Notes to self (informal):
- Keep decision ledger flat and append-only for audit.
- Use short codes (D-###) for decisions so product/legal can reference easily in emails.
- If pilot extends beyond week 10, convert to "extended pilot" path and propose a 30-day checkpoint cadence.

Appendix (links & quick references):
- GH scripts: github.com/redwood-inference/pilot-scripts (runbook under /scripts/smoke.sh)
- Confluence POC template: see linked artifact above
- Recent similar pilot: SE-4092 (notes: large cache effectiveness, recommended cache TTL 5m)

-- end --
